area_note: Highly area-optimized, minimal core. The register file is just 1024 flops. Adding large buffers (e.g., 16 words / 512 bits) inside a custom instruction pays a massive area cost relative to the base machine.
constraints: The PCPI coprocessor interface CANNOT address memory by itself. All operands in memory must be explicitly loaded into registers by base instructions.
Custom instructions can only return a single 32-bit result to the register file per invocation.
The core evaluates PCPI instructions sequentially; it stalls instruction fetch until `pcpi_ready` is asserted.
An instruction can read at most two 32-bit source registers per invocation.
coprocessor: Pico Co-Processor Interface (PCPI). The coprocessor decodes directly from `pcpi_insn`. It receives up to two source registers via `pcpi_rs1` and `pcpi_rs2`, and handshakes via `pcpi_wait` and `pcpi_ready`.
coprocessor_result: A single 32-bit register value (`pcpi_rd`) written to the register file when `pcpi_ready` and `pcpi_wr` are asserted.
custom_opcode_space: Any 32-bit opcode not recognized by the base RV32I decoder triggers the PCPI interface if `WITH_PCPI` is enabled. Custom-0 through Custom-3 are fully available.
evidence: Parameters COMPRESSED_ISA, ENABLE_MUL, ENABLE_DIV in picorv32.v gate the base ISA features.
Multi-cycle execution is evident from cpu_state transitions (fetch -> ld_rs1 -> exec) in picorv32.v.
The lack of memory addressing signals on PCPI (only pcpi_valid, pcpi_insn, pcpi_rs1, pcpi_rs2, pcpi_wr, pcpi_rd, pcpi_wait, pcpi_ready are present).
picorv32_pcpi_mul and picorv32_pcpi_div examples confirm sequential, multi-cycle existing units.
existing_units: Optional sequential shift-add Multiplier (`picorv32_pcpi_mul`) or fast DSP-based Multiplier (`picorv32_pcpi_fast_mul`)
Optional Barrel Shifter (if disabled, shifts take 1 cycle per bit)
isa: RV32I with optional M (multi-cycle or fast) and C (compressed) extensions.
memory_interface: Valid/Ready handshake (`mem_valid`, `mem_ready`) with 32-bit address/data and 4-bit write strobe. The PCPI coprocessor has no access to this interface.
microarchitecture: Multi-cycle state machine (fetch, decode/read, execute, memory, writeback). Typical ALU instructions take 3-4 cycles minimum.
name: picorv32
register_file: 32 registers of 32 bits. Dual-port read is parameterizable and enabled by default.
